app.title: Clash Composer
app.subtitle: Compose and manage Mihomo / Clash configurations

login.title: Sign in
login.description: Enter the API token configured for `clash-composer serve`.

configs.title: Configurations
configs.empty: No configurations yet. Create one to get started.
configs.createDescription: The id becomes the JSON filename under config-dir.
configs.deleteConfirm: Delete configuration "{{id}}"? This removes the JSON file in config-dir.

files.uploadDescription: Save a template or proxy source file under config-dir.
files.pathHelp: Use a relative .yaml or .yml path. Subdirectories are created automatically.

sources.title: Configuration sources
sources.description: Each proxy group can have multiple sources. Each source must set exactly one of path, url, cmd.
sources.groupExists: A group with this name already exists.
sources.deleteGroupConfirm: Delete proxy group "{{name}}" and all its sources?
sources.includeGroupsHelp: Comma-separated proxy group names. They are inserted after the generated url-test group.

providers.title: Rule providers
providers.description: Manages the rule-providers section of the template YAML.
providers.invalidJson: Provider body must be valid JSON.

groups.title: Rule groups
groups.description: Comments before a rule are interpreted as the group name. The default group cannot be renamed or deleted.
groups.addGroupHint: Index must be ≥ 1 (the default group always stays first).
groups.deleteGroupConfirm: Delete group "{{name}}" and all its rules?
groups.ruleIndexLabel: Insert at index (optional, append by default)

subscription.title: Subscription URL
subscription.description: Use this URL inside Mihomo / Clash subscription settings.
subscription.copyHint: URL embeds the API token as a query parameter.

errors.unauthorized: Token expired or invalid. Please sign in again.
